# 1 Enoch Chapter 96 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch — Woe Oracles

---

**96:1** Be-hopeful, ye-righteous; for-suddenly-shall-the-sinners-perish before-you, and-ye-shall-have-lordship-over-them according-to-your-desires.

**96:2** And-in-the-day-of-the-tribulation-of-the-sinners, your-children-shall-mount-and-rise-as-eagles, and-higher-than-the-vultures-shall-be-your-nest, and-ye-shall-ascend-and-enter-the-crevices-of-the-earth, and-the-clefts-of-the-rock-for-ever-as-coneys-before-the-unrighteous, and-the-sirens-shall-wail over-you.

**96:3** Fear-not-ye-who-have-suffered; for-healing-shall-be-your-portion, and-a-bright-light-shall-enlighten-you, and-the-voice-of-rest-ye-shall-hear from-heaven.

**96:4** Woe unto-you, ye-sinners, for-your-riches-make-you-appear-like-the-righteous, but-your-hearts-convict-you-of-being-sinners, and-this-fact-shall-be-a-testimony-against-you for-a-memorial-of-evil-deeds.

**96:5** Woe to-you-who-devour-the-finest-of-the-wheat, and-drink-wine in-large-bowls, and-tread-under-foot-the-lowly with-your-might.

**96:6** Woe to-you-who-drink-water-from-every-fountain, for-suddenly-shall-ye-be-consumed-and-wither-away, because-ye-have-forsaken-the-fountain-of-life.

**96:7** Woe to-you-who-work-unrighteousness-and-deceit-and-blasphemy; it-shall-be-a-memorial-against-you-for-evil.

**96:8** Woe to-you, ye-mighty, who-with-might-oppress-the-righteous; for-the-day-of-your-destruction-is-coming. In-those-days many-and-good-days-shall-come to-the-righteous — in-the-day-of-your-judgment.

---

*EMET notes: V. 2's elaborate imagery (eagles, vultures, coneys) is unusual — the righteous hiding like rock-coneys (hyraxes) while the sinners perish. Some scholars read this as persecution imagery. 'Sirens' (v. 2) may be a Ge'ez rendering of a creature that wails; textual tradition varies. V. 5's 'finest of the wheat' targets those who exploit agricultural labor. V. 6's 'fountain of life' alludes to Jeremiah 2:13 and Psalm 36:9.*
